title: Unified SDK quickstarts: web, backend, and CLI examples with streaming & retry patterns
creator: Arjun Patel
description: Create a set of lightweight, opinionated starter examples and cookbook snippets for Redwood SDKs (Python, TypeScript, Go). Focus on: 1) ergonomics for streaming responses across runtimes (Next.js edge/server, FastAPI, Go net/http), 2) robust retry and idempotency patterns for transient failures, and 3) small CLI examples that demonstrate streaming and configurable backoff. Deliverables should be copy-paste ready, include Docker + CI hints, and short integration tests that can run in CI (unit + e2e smoke).
scope: Next.js quickstart (TS) showing server-side streaming, client consumption, and Edge vs Server runtime notes
FastAPI quickstart (Python) that demonstrates async streaming generator usage and graceful cancellation
Go HTTP server example showing channel-based streaming and cancelation via context
CLI examples in TS (node) and Go that pipe streamed tokens to stdout with backpressure handling
Cookbook snippets: retry with jitter, idempotency tokens for create/completions, reconnect-on-transient, token-level aggregation heuristics
Tests: minimal CI workflow that runs lints and smoke e2e against a sandboxed local runtime
Docs: README per example + short migration notes for customers using old SDK streaming APIs
acceptance_criteria: Four runnable examples checked into examples/sdks/: nextjs-ts, fastapi-py, go-http, cli-extras
Each example includes a README with start commands, Dockerfile, and an example request payload
Streaming ergonomics documented: how to handle partial messages, cancellation, and reconnects for each language
Retry cookbook includes 3 patterns (simple retry, exponential backoff with jitter, idempotent safer retry) and code snippets for each SDK
CI job added to run example smoke tests and validate stream end-to-end (exit code + sample assertions)
PR review from SDK lead and Docs owner completed; at least one internal team (Solutions or SE) validated developer experience
